description: This file defines the DateTimeModel class within the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin API. It models a simple data structure containing UTC date and time information, serializable to an array format for API responses.

classes.name: DateTimeModel
classes.description: A model representing a date and time in UTC, designed for API serialization within the Attendance plugin.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DateTimeModel with a given DateTime object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the DateTimeModel to an associative array with formatted date and time strings.
